rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) annual allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: For RSO units, rent may be raised only once every 12 months, by the LAHD-published allowable rent increase percentage. Effective February 2, 2026, landlords may no longer add an extra percentage increase for utilities. Rent may reset to market on voluntary vacancy or certain at-fault evictions.
rules.key_value: Once per 12 months by LAHD allowable percentage; no utility add-on after 2026-02-02
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental properties in the City of Los Angeles first built on or before October 1, 1978, plus replacement units under LAMC 151.28. Covers apartments, condominiums, townhomes, duplexes, two or more single-family dwellings on one parcel, long-term hotel/motel/rooming house rooms, residential units attached to commercial buildings, ADUs/JADUs, and mobile homes and RVs in mobile home parks.
rules.exemptions: Rent is not regulated for condominium and townhome tenancies that commenced after December 31, 1995. Luxury exemption is available on application. Temporary exemptions may be filed.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Replacement units under LAMC 151.28 are covered regardless of age. Condo/townhome rent is regulated only for tenancies that began on or before 1995-12-31. Luxury exemption.

rules.citation: Los Angeles Municipal Code Ch. XV, Art. 1 (Rent Stabilization Ordinance, LAMC § 151.00 et seq.)
rules.conflict_note: The page says 'first built on or before October 1, 1978'. The RSO ordinance itself keys on certificate of occupancy date, so the cutoff basis may be certificate_of_occupancy. The page does not state the RSO's original effective date.

rules.title: RSO additional-occupant rent increase (dependent increase eliminated)
rules.requirement: Effective February 2, 2026, landlords may not add a 10% increase for an additional dependent. A 10% increase is still allowed for an additional non-dependent tenant, imposed within 60 days of learning of that tenant.
rules.key_value: 10% for additional non-dependent tenant; 0% for dependent (from 2026-02-02)
rules.coverage_conditions: Units subject to the Los Angeles RSO, i.e. first built on or before October 1, 1978.
rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (LAMC § 151.00 et seq.)
rules.quoted_span: Effective February 2, 2026, an additonal 10% increase for an additional dependent added to the tenancy is no longer permitted.
rules.conflict_note: The specific amending ordinance number is not given on the page.

rules.title: Filing of termination notices with LAHD
rules.requirement: Every notice to terminate a tenancy for an RSO unit must be filed with LAHD within three business days after it is served on the tenant.
rules.key_value: File within 3 business days of service
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units subject to the Los Angeles RSO. The cited LAMC 165.05 indicates parallel coverage of Just Cause Ordinance units.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: The requirement is triggered by serving a termination notice.

rules.quoted_span:

rules.title: RSO just-cause eviction and no-fault relocation assistance
rules.requirement: RSO tenants may be evicted only for enumerated at-fault or no-fault reasons. No-fault evictions require a Landlord Declaration of Intent to Evict filed with LAHD, written notice, and payment of tenant relocation assistance.
rules.key_value: Relocation assistance required for no-fault evictions
rules.coverage_conditions: Units subject to the Los Angeles RSO, i.e. first built on or before October 1, 1978.

rules.title: Los Angeles Just Cause Ordinance for non-RSO units
rules.requirement: Rental units in Los Angeles that are not covered by the RSO are still subject to the city's Just Cause Ordinance eviction protections.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental properties in Los Angeles that are not subject to the RSO.
rules.citation: LAMC Ch. XVI, Art. 5 (Just Cause Ordinance, LAMC § 165.00 et seq.)
rules.quoted_span:
Even if your property is not covered under the Rent Stabilization Ordinance, you and your tenants have rights and responsibilities under the

rules.conflict_note: The page gives no details of JCO coverage or exemptions. The post-1978 cutoff is inferred from 'not covered under RSO'.

rules.title: Notice of Right to Counsel posting and delivery
rules.requirement: Landlords must post the Notice of Right to Counsel and give it to the tenant at the start of the tenancy. The notice must also be attached to any eviction notice or rental subsidy termination.
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords of rental units in Los Angeles; the page states this in the context of RSO properties.
rules.citation: Los Angeles Right to Counsel Ordinance (citation not given on page)
